scope: Isolated fitting experiment on a retained genuine layout. Pin residual is distance to authored polyline (80) plus original target anchor (4), with open endpoints fixed. All original acceptance gates including full surface bounds and mixed quad diagonals remain unchanged. Distributed 401-sample guide-to-edge distance (32) and cross-tangent (12.0) residuals replace the midpoint term. Each sample owns its closest connected path edge, updated between passes. Per-guide residual mass is normalized by square root of edge-count/sample-count. Validation still uses the original 257 samples. Source support samples are all source vertices and triangle centroids, fitted separately against both output quad diagonals. The support threshold and every residual weight remain unchanged. No production publication.
